text:
maya: quick review request 11 i'm iterating on the model catalog: small legend for performance badges, filter rail grouping, and pinning behavior in compare. screenshot: https://img.redwood-ui/mockups/model-catalog-legend-v4.png

ben: looks cleaner. what's the exact legend copy now?

maya: current draft:
Performance badges give a quick signal for latency/cost/quality tradeoffs.
Fast  low latency, higher cost.
Efficient  balanced latency and cost.
High quality  best for accuracy-sensitive tasks.

arjun: short lines are good. maybe change "High quality" to "Quality-focused" so it reads as an attribute, not a promise.

tia: accessibility: badges need aria-labels and a 2px outline for small sizes. current amber fails contrast at 12px. i'll post two hex swaps in figma by EOD.

sam: about filters  prefer top-level "Performance" then "Attributes". put counts next to each group (aria-live for updates). keyboard: filter chips focusable, Space/Enter toggles. Home/End jumps groups.

ben: pinning UX: if you pin a version in compare, is it immune to rollouts/auto-swap?

maya: yes, pinned versions should be local to the session, visually persistent, and never auto-swapped. show a "Pinned" chip and allow keyboard toggle. if pinned goes incompatible/offline, show an inline warning and require an explicit fallback action.

arjun: agree. tooltip copy proposal:
Pinned  held for comparison. It won't be auto-swapped by rollouts or filters. Select to unpin.

sam: replace "held for comparison" with "kept for comparison"? both fine. ensure tooltip uses "Select" not "Click" for accessibility. also add aria-describedby linking to a short explainer region.

maya: good call. final microcopy accepted. next steps: tia updates colors/accessibility tokens, ben will tighten microcopy and add keyboard wording, arjun will spec offline fallback modal, sam will prototype keyboard interactions, i'll push the PR with the updated legend + pinned chip visuals.

ui-bot: Reminder: design review sync Thu 10:30am PT in #design-review.

ben: timeline? aiming for lightweight PR by Thu. call blockers out here.

tia: working on color tokens now.

arjun: drafting fallback mock this afternoon.

sam: prototyping keyboard flows tomorrow.

maya: thanks all :heart:
